summary: Frontend-only testing of the new dual-mode MikiLab shell (PIN 1985) at 390x844 and 1920x800. All 5 requested flows PASS: PinLock unlock with 1985, default Floor Mode view with its 3 sections, mode-lab-btn -> lab-control-view with the 3 lab nav cards, lab-nav-iot -> PeripheralSetup panel + Maestro tools, 'Configura tutto' peripheral auto-setup (no JS error, tiles update, toast 'Periferiche configurate: 3/4 attive'), and mode-floor-btn returns to floor-mode-view. No page errors (pageerror) captured during the whole run. Issues found are cosmetic/i18n plus one real mobile layout bug in the PIN keypad.

ui_bugs.issue: Keypad grid uses 'grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3' so at 390px width the 10 keys render as a single stacked column (key 1 at y=104, key 2 at y=180, each 260px wide); keys 0 and delete fall below the fold and require scrolling on a mobile/hands-free device. Should be grid-cols-3 at all breakpoints.
Fixed 'Radio' FAB (bottom-left) overlaps the 'Impostazioni IoT' card title/description text on mobile (390px) - text partially hidden behind the button.

integration_issues.issue: Repeated 401 responses on GET /api/auth/me and /api/favorites/sync fill the console with 'Failed to load resource: 401' (7+ occurrences per page load). Functionally harmless (no user signed in) but should be guarded/silenced.

NOT VERIFIABLE via UI: after opening Lab Control > Impostazioni IoT (Maestro), no 'Smart Planner' entry is rendered anywhere in the DOM, so [data-testid="smart-planner"] / planner-volume / team-day-0 could not be reached. validateBatchQty behaviour therefore remains untested end-to-end.

issues: UI renders in ENGLISH by default ("Enter the security PIN", "Your lab assistant", "MikiLab Recipes", "These are MY recipes...") while the product spec calls for an Italian UI; language selector in header shows EN. Consider defaulting lang to IT.
Helper paragraph and tile status text at 9-10px are very small/low-contrast (#64748B on #0f172a) on a 1920px viewport.

action_items: PinLock: change keypad grid to grid-cols-3 (remove sm:grid-cols-2 / lg:grid-cols-3) so the keypad is a proper 3x4 pad on mobile.
Prevent the RadioFornaio FAB from overlapping card content on mobile (add bottom padding / raise z-index-safe spacing).
Silence or guard the unauthenticated 401 calls to /api/auth/me and /api/favorites/sync.
Expose the Smart Planner tool in the new dual-mode shell (or confirm it is intentionally out of scope) so validateBatchQty can be regression-tested.
Consider defaulting UI language to Italian per product spec.
critical_code_review_comments: peripherals.js checkIoT() swallows all failures into status 'error' - distinguish network failure vs non-200 for better diagnostics; also no timeout on the fetch, so a hung /api/sensors/latest keeps the button in 'Rilevamento...' indefinitely.
PeripheralSetup.run() has no catch: autoSetupPeripherals never throws today, but a future throw would leave no user-facing error (only finally resets busy).
App.js imports useAuth but never uses it beyond import (dead import in the streamlined shell) - verified lint clean, but worth removing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 5 requested flows passed; 2 UI bugs + 1 optional flow unreachable

context_for_next_testing_agent: PIN 1985 unlocks (pin-key-1/9/8/5, auto-submit). Default view = floor-mode-view. Peripheral auto-setup toast is a sonner toast that appears within ~1s and auto-dismisses in ~4s - assert it early (do not wait 7s or you will miss it). In headless Chromium mic+camera resolve 'ok', bluetooth 'unavailable' (N/D), IoT 'ok (2)' => toast reads 3/4. Smart Planner is not rendered in the current Maestro view.
rca_of_the_issue: PinLock mobile bug root cause: responsive grid classes 'grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3' make the keypad 1-column below the sm breakpoint (640px), so on phones the pad is a tall vertical list. Reproduce: viewport 390x844 -> load app -> measure bounding boxes of pin-key-1 and pin-key-2 (different rows, 260px wide each).
